title: Professional Insight: Inspecting Drainage Venting Systems
description: A properly functioning drainage system relies just as heavily on air as it does on water. Without adequate venting, negative pressure can siphon water traps dry, allowing sewer gases to enter the living space and causing slow, gurgling drains. Professional service technicians always check roof vent terminations and branch vents during diagnostic troubleshooting. Recognizing the symptoms of a compromised venting network ensures you address the actual root cause of drainage failures rather than just treating recurring symptoms.
